1: // Simple Meteor Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) {
6:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:     return;
8:   }
9:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
10:   // Set canvas size (can be overridden by CSS)
11:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
12:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
13: 
14:   const ship = {
15:     width: 40,
16:     height: 20,
17:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
18:     y: canvas.height - 30,
19:     speed: 5,
20:     color: '#0f0',
21:   };
22: 
23:   const meteors = [];
24:   const meteorSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
25:   let lastSpawn = 0;
26:   let gameOver = false;
27: 
28:   const keys = {};
29:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
30:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
31: 
32:   function spawnMeteor() {
33:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
34:     meteors.push({
35:       x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
36:       y: -size,
37:       size,
38:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 2,
39:       color: '#888',
40:     });
41:   }
42: 
43:   function update(delta) {
44:     // Move ship
45:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
46:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.x += ship.speed;
47:     // Clamp
48:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width, ship.x));
49: 
50:     // Spawn meteors
51:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > meteorSpawnInterval) {
52:       spawnMeteor();
53:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
54:     }
55: 
56:     // Update meteors
57:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
58:       const m = meteors[i];
59:       m.y += m.speed;
60:       // Remove off‑screen
61:       if (m.y - m.size > canvas.height) meteors.splice(i, 1);
62:     }
63: 
64:     // Collision detection (simple AABB)
65:     for (const m of meteors) {
66:       const shipRect = {x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.width, h: ship.height};
67:       const meteorRect = {x: m.x, y: m.y, w: m.size, h: m.size};
68:       if (
69:         shipRect.x < meteorRect.x + meteorRect.w &&
70:         shipRect.x + shipRect.w > meteorRect.x &&
71:         shipRect.y < meteorRect.y + meteorRect.h &&
72:         shipRect.y + shipRect.h > meteorRect.y
73:       ) {
74:         gameOver = true;
75:         break;
76:       }
77:     }
78:   }
79: 
80:   function draw() {
81:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
82:     // Draw ship
83:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
84:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.width, ship.height);
85:     // Draw meteors
86:     for (const m of meteors) {
87:       ctx.fillStyle = m.color;
88:       ctx.beginPath();
89:       ctx.arc(m.x + m.size / 2, m.y + m.size / 2, m.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
90:       ctx.fill();
91:     }
92:     // Game over overlay
93:     if (gameOver) {
94:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
95:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
96:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
97:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
98:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
99:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
100:     }
101:   }
102: 
103:   let lastTime = 0;
104:   function loop(timestamp) {
105:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
106:     lastTime = timestamp;
107:     if (!gameOver) update(delta);
108:     draw();
109:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
110:   }
111:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
112: })();

(End of file - total 112 lines)
